remarks: Be prepared to be wowed when you view this amazing Pepper Ridge house! This home has luxury features you would find in a $1M+ home. The 1st floor has beautiful new red oak hardwood floors w/Rubio Monocoat finish, new kitchen w/Thermador appliances, Decora kitchen cabinets w/Schaub knobs, undercabinet LED lighting, Emtek door knobs w/solid wood doors, new radiators & baseboard w/shoe molding, lovely covered deck off kitchen for entertaining, powder room, dining room & living room w/limestone & granite fireplace w/custom built-ins. Second floor has two bedrooms w/ceiling fans, refinished hard wood floors w/Rubio Monocoat finish & new radiators. Second floor bathroom has new Ariel vanity w/Soapstone countertop & flooring along w/built-in cabinets for convenient storage. Walk-out basement w/river stone fireplace in the family room, bonus room/office, solid wood stained doors, wall sconces, kitchenette, bath w/walk-in shower & laundry room. Level yard surrounded by arborvitae for privacy with Beacon Hill stone patio area. New 200 amp electrical. Irrigation system completely replaced 2021. Central HVAC, 2 zones; 2nd floor zone replaced 2021 with Trane system. 2021 New roof and flat roof over deck. Alarm system with fire. Updated JUNO lighting with LED lights in majority of home. Transfer switch for generator. Attached one car garage. Far too many update's to detail here so please see attachments.
